exposure: conventional endotracheal intubation for surfactant administration
INSURE (intubation, surfactant administration, and extubation soon after) technique
surfactant through a thin intratracheal catheter
cohort: The study focuses on preterm infants and neonates requiring surfactant administration for respiratory distress syndrome.
finding: Clinical trials examining alternative surfactant delivery methods have shown promising results in reducing mortality and respiratory morbidities, but are not yet conclusive enough for broader adoption into routine clinical practice.
